SecuritiesAccountIdentification.name: Securities Account Identification
SecuritiesAccountIdentification.definition: identification of the securities account to which the securities have to be delivered.

CashAccountIdentification.name: Cash Account Identification
CashAccountIdentification.definition: Identification of the cash account to which the cash has to be delivered.

AccountOwnerIdentification.name: Account Owner Identification
AccountOwnerIdentification.definition: Identification of the party that owns the account.

AccountServicerIdentification.name: Account Servicer Identification
AccountServicerIdentification.definition: Identification of the institution servicing the account.

SecuritiesAccountIdentificationOrCashAcc.definition: Either SecuritiesAccountIdentification or CashAccountIdentification must be present.
Either SecuritiesAccountIdentification or CashAccountIdentification must be present.
